## Headline — the n = 7 height-1 census is CLOSED, and it closed by argument

> **163 of 163 iso classes, 227 892 of 227 892 labelled height-1 vertices, 0 violations.
> Min margin = 4, attained at the two stars.**

Walked there by four tickets in one night: `mg-72e4` published the result over an unstated
denominator; `mg-9cd1` (independent audit) found a **fourth** denominator nobody had stated;
`mg-bcd7` measured the one class an over-cap test had wrongly excluded; `mg-dd84` closed the last
three classes — **by chain-level exactness, not brute force**, in 47.8 s on one core.

**State the limits with it.** Conjecture C is **not** proven and is untouched. The c ≤ 2 slice has
no argument behind it beyond these three named families — L1 and L4 both *fail* for the stars,
where Γ(K_{6,1}) genuinely carries β̃₄ = 1. Nothing is measured at n ≥ 8. Every "contractible"
verdict is **Q-acyclicity**, not contractibility.

## Backlog (parked deliberately — 22 items)

All 22 are `INDEPENDENT AUDIT` items. **Their ageing is intentional** per the 2026-08-07
risk-first ruling: audits dispatch Tier-1 first (live work consuming the audited claim), then
Tier 2 (ordered behind a writer), and Tier-3 chore audits are not backlog and should not be
surfaced as such. One was converted to a real `--depends` this sweep (mg-8d4b → mg-5998) because
its subject is a claims item.

## Trajectory

- **7-day spend:** `onethird` 200 items / 42.2 M tokens; `audit` 33 / 7.0 M;
  `independent-audit` 22 / 5.1 M; `frankl` 7 / 1.7 M.
- **Audit share is ~29 % of items.** That is the 2026-08-07 ruling holding — it was 70 % of
  *available* items when the drift was caught.
- **Throughput:** 25 items closed in the last 24 h, three repos, zero rollbacks.
- **Bottleneck: cores, not workers.** The per-repo dispatch cap of 3 counts workers; a single
  step reaching 4.4 cores through BLAS is invisible to it (mg-6476, and pogo-side mg-1d05).
- **Gate posture, corrected this sweep:** both repos have a blocking refinery gate at
  `.pogo/refinery.toml`. width_three's is paths-filtered and does not cover the doc controls;
  those run only in Actions, which informs and does not block. That is why main was red for five
  hours and nothing stopped a merge.
